title: AE Indices (Best Available, 1-minute)
description: Auroral electrojet indices AE, AL, AU, AO (1-minute): a measure of global electrojet activity in the auroral zone, derived from H-component variations at observatories along the northern-hemisphere auroral zone. Provided by WDC for Geomagnetism, Kyoto. Best Available version: highest processing level per period (Final > Provisional > Real-time). Timestamps are bin centers on the UT minute (timeStampLocation=center).
datasetCitation: World Data Center for Geomagnetism, Kyoto, M. Nose, T. Iyemori, M. Sugiura, T. Kamei, A. Matsuoka, S. Imajo, and T. Kotani (2015), Geomagnetic AE index, doi:10.17593/15031-54800

parameters.name: versionCode
parameters.label: Version Code
parameters.description: Processing status code Mm (M: 0=real-time,1=provisional,2=final; m=minor, the recalculation generation within the same major: 0=first conversion, 1 and above=reconverted after the source changed).
